checks.finding: Tier-2 combined and three printable entries conform.
Three one-solid print targets sit on Z=0 and fit a 120 × 120 mm bed.
Bores, keyways, side clearance, connector names, and assembly order derive from one parameter source.
A relocated copy containing only the CAD project passed the complete fresh export and strict-fit pipeline; both local audits run without workspace-relative imports.
Three independent fresh processes produced the same combined STEP bytes; a host-equivalent copied-project pipeline left every generated CAD output byte-identical.
8.350 mm exchange difference, 0.862 mm full-solid floor clearance, and 1.692 mm locked-tab engagement.
Both ±8° rocker sweeps and the 90° axle lock rotation are clear; locked axial withdrawal is blocked as intended.
Assembly and all three part STEP entries have valid closed positive-volume solids with no reported self-intersection.
Three assembly pairs tested; zero clashes above the 1.0 mm³ contact tolerance.
Every print-target STL and the three-shell assembled STL are watertight, manifold, consistently wound, positive-volume, and bed-fitting.
All three print-target meshes have zero sampled surface below the 0.80 mm two-line wall threshold at a 0.4 mm nozzle.
Four orthographic views from the exact assembled STL show all parts present, centered, supported, and consistent with the brief.

limitations: No successful print or physical fit is claimed.
Rigid digital motion does not prove friction, retention force, strength, wear, durability, or cycle life.
Visual review does not replace topology, interference, mesh, or thickness checks.
